string.name: emailConfirm_click
string.comment:
emailConfirm_click
Part of the confirmation email upon registering for a Lichess account.
The unique reset link is presented just after this string.

resources.string: Click the link to enable your GoGame account:
If you did not register with GoGame, you can safely ignore this message. The unconfirmed account and all traces of your email address will be deleted from our system after 48 hours.
We received a request to reset the password for your account.
If you made this request, click the link below. If not, you can ignore this email.
You have requested to change your email address.
To confirm you have access to this email, please click the link below:

You have successfully created your account.
Here is your profile page: %1$s. You can personalize it on %2$s.
Have fun, and may your stones always live!
